blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Leylah Fernandez rallied past Poland’s Maja Chwalinska, 1-6, 6-4, 6-2, to reach the Singapore Open final on Saturday night at OCBC Arena Center Court. Fernandez delivered a beeline backhand winner to put away the French Open runner-up Chwalinska and clinch her first final appearance this season. The 24-year-old Fernandez faces Australia’s Talia Gibson in the final on Sunday.
